title.zh: Cloudflare推出面向AI代理的稳定币支付封闭测试版
title.en: Cloudflare Launches Closed Beta for Stablecoin Payments to AI Agents

current_state.zh: Cloudflare 已开启代币化 Monetization Gateway 的封闭测试，允许网站通过 HTTP 402 按请求、查询或 Token 向 AI Agent 收费，并以 USDC 在 Base 区块链上结算，扩展了面向自主机器间商业的加密支付通道。
current_state.en: Cloudflare has opened a closed beta of its tokenized Monetization Gateway, allowing websites to charge AI agents per request, query, or token via HTTP 402 with USDC settlements on Base, extending crypto payment rails into autonomous machine-to-machine commerce.

updates.title_zh: 【Cloudflare 代币化网关开放封闭测试，支持 AI Agent 按量付费】
updates.title_en: 【Cloudflare 代币化网关开放封闭测试，支持 AI Agent 按量付费】
updates.what_changed_zh: Cloudflare 的封闭测试针对其代币化 Monetization Gateway，网站可通过 HTTP 402 按请求、查询或 Token 向 AI Agent 收费，并使用 USDC 在 Base 区块链上结算，应用场景包括 AI 推理、网页搜索、市场信号及 PDF 生成。
updates.what_changed_en: Cloudflare's closed beta is for its tokenized Monetization Gateway, letting websites charge AI agents per request, query, or token via HTTP 402 with USDC settlements on Base, for use cases including AI inference, web search, market signals, and PDF generation.
